title: Mr. Loverman
lyrics:
[00:01.09]I'm headed straight for the floor
[00:06.36]The alcohol served its tour
[00:11.87]And it's headed straight for my skin
[00:17.55]Leaving me daft and dim
[00:23.28]I've got this shake in my legs
[00:28.55]Shaking the thoughts from my head
[00:33.94]But who put these waves in the door?
[00:39.71]I crack and out I pour
[00:45.26]I'm Mr. Loverman
[00:50.54]And I miss my lover, man
[00:56.36]I'm Mr. Loverman
[01:00.63]Oh and I miss my lover
[01:07.18]The ways in which you talk to me
[01:12.23]Have me wishin' I were gone
[01:18.27]The ways that you say my name
[01:23.11]Have me runnin' on and on
[01:30.02]Oh, I'm cramping up
[01:33.30]I'm cramping up
[01:41.21]But you're cracking up
[01:44.09]You're cracking up
[01:51.75]I'm Mr. Loverman
[01:56.98]And I miss my lover, man
[02:02.82]I'm Mr. Loverman
[02:07.25]Oh and I miss my lover
[02:14.71]I've shattered now, I'm spilling out
[02:20.12]Upon this linoleum ground
[02:26.10]I'm reeling in my brain again
[02:31.27]Before it can get back to you
[02:36.07]Oh what am I supposed to do without you?
[02:47.07]I'm Mr. Loverman
[02:52.46]And I miss my lover, man
[02:58.25]I'm Mr. Loverman
[03:02.61]Oh and I miss my lover
[03:09.25]I'm Mr. Loverman
[03:14.60]And I miss my lover, man
[03:20.28]I'm Mr. Loverman
[03:25.79]And I miss my lover
